name: Jupiter
tagline: Solana DEX aggregator APIs for quotes, swaps, prices, and token data
description: Jupiter is Solana’s primary liquidity infrastructure API suite: swap routing (Metis and multi-router Swap V2), USD prices, token metadata, limit/DCA orders, lending, and more. Legacy quote-api.jup.ag was retired; current traffic goes to api.jup.ag with optional free or paid API keys. Free tier is rate-limited only; paid tiers add higher RPS and credit allowances.

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header from free self-serve Portal (developers.jup.ag/portal). Keyless access allowed at lower limits (0.5 RPS).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API key: unlimited credits, 1 req/s (60/min). Keyless: 0.5 req/s (30/min). No payment required.
pricing.paid_plans: Developer $25/mo (10 RPS, 25M credits); Launch $100/mo (50 RPS, 100M credits); Pro $500/mo (150 RPS, 500M credits); overage $1/M credits

rate_limits: 60s sliding window per org: Keyless 0.5 RPS/30 RPM; Free 1 RPS/60 RPM; Developer 10 RPS; Launch 50 RPS; Pro 150 RPS. /swap/v2/execute has a separate bucket (Keyless 20 / Free 50 / Paid 100 RPS).
use_cases: get best-route quote for a Solana token pair (e.g. SOL to USDC)
build and execute a managed swap transaction via Swap V2 order/execute
fetch USD prices for up to 50 Solana mints in one request
search Solana tokens by name, symbol, or mint with trading metadata
create vault-based limit orders or DCA schedules on Solana
